scenes.say: How big a Formula One fan are you? Six easy questions, three seconds each. Keep score!
Question one. How many points does the race winner get? Ten, eighteen, or twenty-five?
Twenty-five! Tenth place gets just one point.
Question two. Who won the twenty twenty-five world title? Norris, Verstappen, or Piastri?
Lando Norris! He beat Verstappen by just two points.
Question three. How many cars start a race in twenty twenty-six? Twenty, twenty-two, or twenty-four?
Twenty-two! Cadillac made it eleven teams, with two cars each.
Question four. What does the blue flag mean? Danger, race stopped, or you're about to be lapped?
You're about to be lapped, so let the faster car through. Ignore three blue flags and you can get a penalty.
Question five. How many world titles does Lewis Hamilton have? Seven, six, or five?
Seven! The same as Michael Schumacher, a shared record.
Last one. How many dry tyre compounds does Pirelli bring to a race weekend? Two, three, or five?
Three: soft, medium and hard, picked from this season's five compounds.
Six out of six: you're a true fan! Four or five: a solid fan. Fewer: time to watch more races.
Drop your score in the comments, and follow the races on the LapRadar live map.

title: How big an F1 fan are you? Easy level
caption: How big an F1 fan are you? 6 questions, easy level, 3 seconds each. Drop your score in the comments! Live race map: lapradar.com
